# demo-compilation
  ffmpeg
  -y
  -v
  error
  -i
  $WORK/recording/segments/seg-004.mp4
  -i
  $WORK/recording/segments/seg-011.mp4
  -i
  $WORK/recording/segments/seg-002.mp4
  -i
  $WORK/render/player-card-carta.png
  -i
  $WORK/render/player-card-mvp.png
  -filter_complex
    [0:v]scale=w=1080:h=1920:force_original_aspect_ratio=increase:eval=init:flags=lanczos+accurate_rnd+full_chroma_int
    crop=1080:1920:(iw-ow)/2:(ih-oh)/2
    setsar=1
    fps=60
    format=yuv420p
    trim=end_frame=427
    setpts=PTS-STARTPTS[pv0]
    [0:a]aformat=channel_layouts=stereo
    aresample=48000
    atrim=duration=7.116667
    asetpts=PTS-STARTPTS[pa0]
    [1:v]scale=w=1080:h=1920:force_original_aspect_ratio=increase:eval=init:flags=lanczos+accurate_rnd+full_chroma_int
    crop=1080:1920:(iw-ow)/2:(ih-oh)/2
    setsar=1
    fps=60
    format=yuv420p
    trim=end_frame=285
    setpts=PTS-STARTPTS[pv1]
    [1:a]aformat=channel_layouts=stereo
    aresample=48000
    atrim=duration=4.750000
    asetpts=PTS-STARTPTS[pa1]
    [2:v]scale=w=1080:h=1920:force_original_aspect_ratio=increase:eval=init:flags=lanczos+accurate_rnd+full_chroma_int
    crop=1080:1920:(iw-ow)/2:(ih-oh)/2
    setsar=1
    fps=60
    format=yuv420p
    trim=end_frame=360
    setpts=PTS-STARTPTS[pv2]
    [2:a]aformat=channel_layouts=stereo
    aresample=48000
    atrim=duration=6.000000
    asetpts=PTS-STARTPTS[pa2]
    [pv0][pa0][pv1][pa1][pv2][pa2]concat=n=3:v=1:a=1[catv][gamea]
    [catv]eq=contrast=1.180:saturation=1.280:gamma=1.020
    format=yuv420p[vbase]
    [3:v]format=rgba
    scale=w=1080:h=1920:flags=lanczos
    loop=loop=-1:size=1:start=0
    setpts=N/60/TB
    trim=duration=1.217
    fade=t=in:st=0:d=0.300:alpha=1
    fade=t=out:st=0.900:d=0.300:alpha=1
    setpts=PTS-STARTPTS+0.000/TB[img0]
    [vbase][img0]overlay=x=0:y=0:format=auto:eof_action=pass:repeatlast=0:enable='between(t\,0.000\,1.200)'[vimg0]
    [4:v]format=rgba
    scale=w=1080:h=1920:flags=lanczos
    loop=loop=-1:size=1:start=0
    setpts=N/60/TB
    trim=duration=3.017
    fade=t=in:st=0:d=0.300:alpha=1
    setpts=PTS-STARTPTS+14.859/TB[img1]
    [vimg0][img1]overlay=x=0:y=0:format=auto:eof_action=pass:repeatlast=0:enable='between(t\,14.859\,17.859)'[vimages]
    [vimages]format=yuv420p[v]
    [gamea]loudnorm=I=-16:TP=-1.5:LRA=11[a]
  -map
  [v]
  -map
  [a]
  -c:v
  libx264
  -preset
  slow
  -crf
  16
  -c:a
  aac
  -b:a
  192k
  -movflags
  +faststart
  $WORK/render/short-001-demo-compilation.mp4

# demo-compilation cover
  ffmpeg
  -y
  -v
  error
  -ss
  1.200
  -i
  $WORK/render/short-001-demo-compilation.mp4
  -i
  $WORK/render/player-card-ficha.png
  -frames:v
  1
  -filter_complex
    [0:v]thumbnail=30
    scale=1080:1920:force_original_aspect_ratio=increase:flags=lanczos+accurate_rnd+full_chroma_int
    crop=1080:1920
    setsar=1[frame]
    [1:v]format=rgba
    scale=1080:1920[card]
    [frame][card]overlay=0:0:format=auto
  -q:v
  2
  $WORK/publish/01_demo-compilation_target_de_mirage_5k_ak47.cover.jpg
